edges.reason: msg.sender indexes the rewards mapping and is the payout receiver in getReward

normalization_plan.reason: account only parameterises the updateReward modifier's per-account checkpoint writes
reward is the input amount consumed by the rewardRate arithmetic in notifyRewardAmount
_rewardsDuration only sets the rewardsDuration state used by notifyRewardAmount
user identifies the borrower in mint (and the parallel burn path); it is scoped to those debt functions
onBehalfOf is the debt token recipient and reward checkpoint target of mint
amount is the un-scaled debt amount minted
index is the reserve variable debt index used to scale amount inside mint
from is the debit side of the internal _transfer override
to is the credit side of the internal _transfer override
local reward is the cached payout amount inside getReward before zeroing rewards[msg.sender]
balance is the contract reward token balance read by notifyRewardAmount for the rewardRate cap
remaining is the current-period leftover time computed in notifyRewardAmount
leftover is the undistributed reward folded into the new rewardRate in notifyRewardAmount
localCounter is the nonReentrant guard snapshot protecting getReward's external transfer
amountScaled is the index-scaled amount applied by burn (and symmetrically by mint)
previousBalance is the pre-mint scaled balance checked by mint before returning
scaledBalance is the raw scaled balance read at the start of balanceOf
